thread:
Zoe: Quick check before I lock the weekly KPI deck : launch-posts CPL looks artificially low but webinar registrations & SFDC leads are lower than the dashboard says. Anyone else seeing a data mismatch?
Marco: Yep. Dash shows CPL -25% vs baseline but raw registered leads in the portal are down ~30.
Aisha: inbound routing queue had a mini-stall around 11:40 UTC due to a consumer restart. Could've impacted near-real-time attribution.
Tom: running a minute window join to compare tracked conversions vs portal rows now. Will paste SQL.
Tom: ```sql
SELECT date_trunc('minute', ts) ts_min, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event='click') clicks, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event='register') regs
FROM events_raw
WHERE campaign='launch_posts' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-25 11:30:00' AND '2026-03-25 12:00:00'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
```
Tom: quick summary: clicks ~950, regs tracked 12, portal rows 28 for same window.
Aisha: so ~16 registrations made it to portal but not to event pipeline. Likely consumer lag + a recent schema validation change we merged yesterday.
ops-bot: deploy-log: validation-change merged to event-ingest at 2026-03-25T11:35:10Z by @Sam. Consumer restarted at 11:38 UTC, observed lag spike 11:38-11:48 UTC.
Marco: webinar planning note: if we present CPL numbers in the webinar playbook they'll be misleading. Suggest a single-slide note + delay external email until reconciliation.
Zoe: agreed. Analytics, can you run a fast backfill estimate and flag how many leads are recoverable vs lost?
analytics-bot: backfill-estimate: probable recoverable events: 14; unrecoverable (no payloads): 2. Backfill job queued (id: bf-3122223355). ETA 20m.
Tom: also flagging messaging iteration B deployed at 10:00 PDT had a smaller submit button change. Might slightly lower UX conversion. We'll run variant lift analysis post-backfill.
Aisha: action items: 1) ops to surface exact offsets + confirm no tombstone deletion during lag. 2) analytics to run variant split and reconcile portal rows after backfill. 3) Zoe to add caveat slide and hold external KPI email until results.
ops-bot: offsets: topic launch-posts partition 3 offsets 1245234..1248582 during lag window. No tombstone deletions detected.
analytics-bot: backfill completed: reconciled +13 events. Net remaining gap vs portal: -3 (provisional). Variant-split pre/post deploy: variant A conv 2.2%, B conv 1.0% during affected window.
Legal: quick flag : if analytics plan to synthesize leads from logs we need an audit trail and marketing must label them as "reconciled provisional" before any external outreach.
Zoe: copy. We'll label reconciled leads and keep the external email on hold. Marco, update the webinar narrative to mention a data reconciliation footnote and include the variant B pause recommendation.
Marco: will update the deck and add a short benchmark slide showing baseline vs adjusted numbers with a footnote.
Tom: follow-up for next week: add a health check to the KPI deck pipeline that alerts when portal_count != tracked_count by >15% for 15m. Saves us future surprises.
Aisha: will draft the alert rule and post to #eng-ops.
Zoe: thanks team. Closing this thread; will reopen if backfill doesn't fully reconcile. :white_check_mark:
